provider: Instituto para el Registro del Territorio del Estado de Colima (IRTEC), Government of Colima; public Geoportal/Visualizador Catastral
scope: State cadastral visualizer with municipal and parcel layers; exact-point evidence is local to the WUP point and does not prove citywide completeness.
officialCustodyEvidence: https://www.col.gob.mx/Portal/DetalleTramiteReTYS2/1654 states that IRTEC provides the public cadastral visualizer, names the viewer URL, says the consultation is free and public, and describes lookup by cadastral key, address or cartographic location.

discoveryAndRequests.route: Official Government of Colima IRTEC service page
discoveryAndRequests.outcome: 200/search result; first-party custody and viewer URL confirmed.

discoveryAndRequests.route: IRTEC viewer HTML and current JavaScript
discoveryAndRequests.outcome: 200; JavaScript exposed EPSG:32613, WMS layer configuration, and public POST routes omba, occa, cic, oag, dc and bpc.
200 JSON; public layers included predios_urbanosv, predios_rusticosv and predios_ejidalesv. Urban layer was marked information_i=si, padron=si, zoom 19-22.
200 text response; returned native cadastral identity 020104070014000. The same result was returned at zoom levels 19, 20, 21 and 22.
200 GeoJSON-like FeatureCollection; one MultiPolygon in EPSG:32613 returned, with empty properties. Geometry was transformed to EPSG:4326 for the retained sample.

discoveryAndRequests.route: GeoServer WFS capabilities and bounded feature attempt
discoveryAndRequests.outcome: 200 XML error response explicitly stated that WFS is disabled; no WFS geometry was retained.
200 JSON with zero features; not treated as absence because the viewer's authoritative public cic/bpc route returned a parcel at the same WUP point.

schemaAndCrs: Viewer JavaScript defines EPSG:32613 (UTM zone 13 WGS84). bpc returned a MultiPolygon with source CRS urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::32613. Retained GeoJSON is transformed to WGS84 longitude/latitude coordinate order.
nativeIdentity: 020104070014000, also displayed by the viewer's dc response as formatted Clave 02-01-04-070-014-000 and ID_ 020104070014000. This is the native cadastral key, not a synthetic row number.

safeIdentityMapping.id: cic/bpc clave_catastro; dc.ID_ / dc.Clave normalized without separators

requestOutcome: First-party English and Spanish discovery succeeded. Viewer/configuration and exact-point public parcel requests succeeded. WFS is disabled; WMS GetFeatureInfo returned no feature for the tested pixel; no citywide bounded download was established.
retainedProperties: Exactly one canonical native identity is retained as properties.id; no raw source-specific attributes are retained.
scopeLimits: The exact-point hit proves one public urban cadastral parcel at the WUP coordinate, not citywide coverage.
The current public layer configuration includes urban, rustic and ejidal parcel layers with different zoom ranges; only the urban layer was queried at the exact point.
WFS was disabled and no anonymous citywide geometry endpoint was verified.
A WMS zero-feature response was not interpreted as absence.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA or Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner/address fields, or TLS exception was used.
RuntimeReadiness remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
uncertainty: A serial reviewer should verify public-service durability, bounded query behavior, native-key stability, layer completeness and adapter safety before admission.
